required_inputs: pinned static evidence named by the handoff
optional_inputs: accepted 02-code-index summary (served through the code_* query tools)
allowed_actions: read the assigned control fragments and their pinned static evidence
assess only the proof obligations assigned by the handoff
cite exact pinned evidence for every supported control verdict
emit cannot verify and coverage gaps when evidence is insufficient
draft inert dynamic test requests without executing them
emit candidate followup routes without promoting a finding
query the run evidence index and the accepted code index; results are locators, cite only pinned evidence read
isolation: Persona cell receives only bounded pinned bytes and read-only queries over the hash-bound accepted code index; no network, target execution, target mutation, credentials, dynamic execution or manual observation.
disallowed_actions: claim exploitability or observed runtime state
promote a control result to a finding, severity, remediation state, compliance score or certification
